title: One works well, one keeps falling down.
text: One works well, one keeps falling down.. So far so good. I bought the two pack, and one of them (and only one. oddly) has fallen off the wall a couple of times in the shower. This wouldn't be a problem if I had not stepped on it, not realizing it had fallen off. OUCH. It went back on the wall though. I do think it might be defective though, as the other one has stayed put just fine, and they both have the exact same thing hanging from them: a shower pouf.
